name: Ideals
description: A d100 table of ideals related to The Veil of Crimson Blood campaign's central themes of memory and metaphysical decay.

results.description: Preservation: The Blight is a force of erasure. It is your sacred duty to preserve memories, history, and ancient lore, for without them, what remains is an empty shell.
Truth: The past is riddled with half-truths and corrupted memories. You seek to uncover the true history of Vespera Pyne and the Blight, no matter how painful the revelations may be.
Purpose: Your past is a mystery, a blank slate. You believe your purpose is to forge a new identity, one that is not defined by what you have forgotten, but by the actions you take now.
Redemption: You have an unshakable feeling that you have committed a great wrong in your forgotten past. You are on a quest to atone for a sin you cannot remember, driven by a deep sense of guilt.
Legacy: The world is fading, and soon all will be forgotten. You are determined to leave behind a legacy so powerful that even the Blight cannot erase it.
Order: The metaphysical decay is a form of chaos. You believe that by bringing order and structure to the world, you can halt the spread of the Blight and save existence from its effects.
Sacrifice: The world is worth saving, even if it means sacrificing yourself and your own memories to keep it whole. The needs of the many outweigh the needs of the one.
Love: You fight to protect the memories of those you love most, clinging to every shared moment and vowing to never let them be forgotten.
Community: The only way to survive the Blight is to band together. You believe in strengthening bonds with others and creating a communal memory that can resist decay.
Hope: Even in the face of widespread erasure, you hold on to the hope that a cure can be found and the world's memories can be restored.
Knowledge: The answers to the Blight and Vespera's true nature are hidden in forgotten texts and forbidden knowledge. You will stop at nothing to uncover them.
Justice: You are haunted by a sense of injustice from your past. You believe in righting the wrongs of a forgotten history, even if you can't remember the details.
Freedom: You believe that true freedom is found in a life unburdened by the past. You fight to free others from the grasp of corrupted memories and the weight of history.
Self-Discovery: Your quest is a personal journey to understand who you were before the Blight. You believe that only by knowing yourself can you truly fight the coming darkness.
Rebellion: You believe the current state of the world is a failed system. You will tear down the old ways to build a new society that is immune to the Blight's influence.
Beauty: You are a creator, an artist who finds meaning in the beauty of the world. You believe that the only way to fight the Blight is to fill the world with things too beautiful to be forgotten.
Purity: You believe that the Blight is a form of corruption. Your ideal is to purify yourself and the world from its influence, even if it means sacrificing some memories along the way.
Connection: The Blight isolates people by severing their pasts. You believe in the power of human connection and strive to forge new relationships to combat the loneliness of a fading world.
Patience: The fight against the Blight is not a sprint, but a marathon. You believe that slow, deliberate progress and careful planning are the only ways to truly win.
Humility: You believe that humanity's hubris is what led to the Blight. You advocate for a more humble approach, living in harmony with the world rather than trying to control it.
Empowerment: You seek to empower others, giving them the tools and knowledge to fight the Blight on their own terms. You believe that a united front is the strongest defense.
Solitude: You believe that the only way to truly fight the Blight is to sever all connections and rely on yourself. You are a lone wolf, unwilling to risk others for your cause.
Loyalty: Your loyalty to your companions is your greatest strength. You would never abandon those who have helped you, no matter what happens to their memories.
Acceptance: You have accepted that memories fade and the world decays. You believe that the best way to live is to embrace the impermanence of existence and find peace in it.
Adaptability: The Blight is ever-changing. You believe that you must be able to adapt to survive, shedding old beliefs and forging new ones as the world shifts around you.
Vigilance: You believe that the only way to protect the world from the Blight is to be constantly vigilant. You are a tireless sentinel, always on the lookout for signs of decay.
Responsibility: You feel a deep sense of responsibility to the world. You believe it is your duty to protect it from the Blight, even if you don't know why.
Curiosity: You are driven by an insatiable curiosity about the nature of the Blight. You believe that understanding it is the first step to defeating it.
Balance: The world is in a constant state of flux between creation and destruction. You believe that you must find a balance between the two to save it from the Blight's influence.
Courage: You believe that the only way to face the Blight is with unwavering courage. You are a beacon of hope for others, inspiring them to fight on in the face of despair.
Rebirth: The Blight is a cleansing fire, destroying the old to make way for the new. You believe in embracing this change and ushering in a new era of existence.
Empathy: You believe that empathy is the only way to connect with others and truly understand their struggles. You are a healer, helping others to cope with their forgotten pasts.
Self-Control: The Blight preys on the mind's weaknesses. You believe that by mastering your own mind and emotions, you can resist its influence and remain whole.
Innovation: You believe that the old ways are not enough to fight the Blight. You are a creative thinker, constantly seeking new and innovative solutions to the world's problems.
Pity: You feel a deep sense of pity for those who have lost their memories to the Blight. You believe that it is your duty to help them, even if they can't remember who you are.
Growth: The world is meant to grow and evolve. You believe that the Blight is a natural part of this process and that you must embrace it to find a new way of living.
Wisdom: You believe that true wisdom is found in understanding the past. You are a scholar, poring over ancient texts to find the answers to the world's problems.
Honor: You are a person of honor, living by a strict code of conduct. You believe that by adhering to your principles, you can remain true to yourself, even if your memories fade.
Charity: You believe in giving to others without expecting anything in return. You are a selfless soul, dedicating your life to helping those who have been forgotten by the world.
Loyalty: Your loyalty to your companions is your greatest strength. You would never abandon those who have helped you, no matter what happens to their memories.
Power: You seek power, believing that only through strength can you protect the world from the Blight's influence. You are a formidable warrior, unafraid to do what must be done.

Survival: You believe that the only way to survive the Blight is to be ruthless. You are a pragmatist, willing to make difficult choices to ensure your own survival and the survival of those you love.
Diligence: The fight against the Blight requires constant effort. You are a hard worker, dedicating your life to your cause and never giving up, no matter how difficult the journey becomes.
Vengeance: You have an intense desire for vengeance against those who caused the Blight. You will stop at nothing to see them pay for their crimes, even if it means sacrificing your own morality.
Humor: The world is a dark and serious place. You believe in the power of laughter and humor to lighten the load and bring joy to those who have forgotten how to smile.
